_comment: Versioned pack manifest of the product (parameter framework ZCA_PARAM + operations framework ZCA_OPS): releases, components, prerequisites, packs with their objects, catalogue processes, checks, licence modules, seed data, source contracts, activation steps and fixtures, import order, blank-slate rules, namespace rules and the distributable set. Membership is derived from rules (folders, name patterns, seed keys), never from a hand list of objects, so a new object or row lands in its pack without editing this file. tools/release_manifest.py --check validates it against the repository and generates release/MANIFEST.md (docs/RELEASE_AND_INSTALL.md). Paths are relative to the repository root unless a field says otherwise.
name: Operations framework with parameter framework, Release 1 (FI-CA Cash Operations)

supported_releases.product: SAP S/4HANA 2023, on-premise or private edition (classic ABAP, RAP with draft, OData V4)
supported_releases.note: Release 1 is claimed only for this release and for the variants proven in the pilot.

supported_releases.product: SAP S/4HANA 2025 with FI-CA (reference system A4H, client 100)
supported_releases.note: First install proof route (the harness); not a supported target until qualified on its own.

software.text: abapGit (standalone report or developer version) in the development system - install route of the components (offline ZIP per component)
ABAP Development Tools for the service bindings, ABAP Unit, ATC and the install harness (tools/qualify)

basis.text: Application log object ZCA_OPS with sub-object ALERT (alert channel APPLOG)
E-mail template ZCA_OPS_ALERT_DEFAULT created from templates/ (optional, built-in renderer otherwise)
Licence only: SSF application, PSE (parameter LIC_SSF_PROFILE) and the vendor certificate (STRUST). Not needed to install or activate - LIC_ENFORCE is delivered W
Distribution lists of the customer for the e-mail channel (configuration after the install, never delivered)
Roles of the customer built from docs/auth_zca_ops.md and the parameter framework's role proposal (authorisation objects ZCA_OPS, ZCA_PARAM)

fica.text: FI-CA dictionary objects (contract accounting tables) must exist for objects that read them; the pack's processes need FI-CA in use

licensing.statement: Activation and installation never depend on a licence: every object activates and every test runs with no licence installed and LIC_ENFORCE = W (harness stage licensing, V208). A licence only switches modules at run time.

activation.text: Import param-framework (abapGit offline ZIP or tools/qualify), activate; packages ZCA_PARAM, ZCA_PARAM_UI
Service binding ZUI_CA_PARAM_O4 (OData V4 - UI) on service definition ZUI_CA_PARAM, publish
Roles from the parameter framework's role proposal (authorisation object ZCA_PARAM, field ZCA_PARAR)

fixtures.text: ABAP Unit test classes of the parameter framework (HARMLESS, SHORT)

activation.text: Import ops-framework without src/demo (abapGit offline ZIP or tools/qualify), activate; packages ZCA_OPS, ZCA_OPS_UI
Service bindings <service definition>_O4 (OData V4 - UI) on every service definition of src/ui, publish
SLG0 object ZCA_OPS / ALERT; roles from docs/auth_zca_ops.md; optional SMTG template from templates/
Parameter seed: run ZCL_CA_OPS_PARAM_SEED (area CA_OPS, definitions with defaults; LIC_ENFORCE stays W)
Customizing request: product rows of the seed files of this pack (catalogue S4CORE, link layer S4CORE, break buckets, check registry)
Demo pack in a sandbox (optional) and the check runner in test mode for area CA_OPS (docs/INSTALL.md section 7)

fixtures.text: ABAP Unit test classes of the framework (OSQL / CDS test doubles, HARMLESS, SHORT)
Worked example of a customer layer (fictitious customer XX)
Worked example of a customer overlay of the link registry

activation.text: Customizing request: product rows of the seed files of this pack (catalogue package FICA, link layer FICA, break rules, account flow templates) - every monitoring row and flow template delivered inactive
Catalogue activation of the qualified processes of this pack from a date, with reason and approver (four-eyes) - effective-dated, reversible
Per process: area, owner, approved tables (security sign-off), checks, control, alert rule (docs/ADDING_A_BUSINESS_PROCESS.md)
VERIFY items of the pack (catalogue V124-V129, links V116-V120, breaks V135-V138, flows V145-V149, cash checks V220-V237) and the cash fixtures config/cash/fixtures.json

fixtures.text: Account flow templates DISB / COLL (inactive) checked by tools/checks.py flow_config
Break buckets and product rules checked by tools/checks.py break_rules

activation.text: Not part of Release 1: catalogue rows are delivered, every monitoring row inactive
Sandbox only (tools/qualify --with-demo): report ZCA_OPS_DEMO in test mode; never imported into production

fixtures.text: ABAP Unit test classes of the demo consumer

seed._comment: Seed rows (configuration, entered in a customizing request after the install; the harness never writes them). Each row belongs to exactly one pack: by its key column and the pack's seed_keys (package / area / layer = equal, prefix = starts with), or the whole file by a pack's seed_files.

manual_objects.rule: one binding <service definition>_O4 per service definition (not serialized by abapGit; created and published in ADT)

manual_objects.text: Role proposal names Z_CA_OPS_* and Z_CA_PARAM_* (PFCG, built by the customer)

blank_slate._comment: Rules of a product delivered with no first-customer data (offline, tools/release_manifest.py --check). The deny list built from the first consumer is a root test (tools/tests/test_blank_slate.py) so its words never enter the product.

distribution._comment: The distributable set of a component is its folder minus these paths (relative to the repository root). The term lists name the first customer's banks, systems and object prefixes on purpose (house check customer_terms); a commercial delivery replaces them with an empty list (decision D-M3).
